displayName: ClickUp DevTimer - Smart Time Tracker for ClickUp
description: Seamless, active-time tracking for ClickUp tasks directly from the VS Code status bar, with idle detection.
walkthrough.title: Get Started with ClickUp DevTimer
walkthrough.description: Connect ClickUp and log your coding time in under a minute.
walkthrough.connect.title: Connect ClickUp
walkthrough.connect.description:
Paste your ClickUp Personal Token. Get it in ClickUp under **Settings › Apps › API Token**. It is kept in your OS keychain.
[Set Personal Token](command:clickupDevTimer.setToken)
walkthrough.workspace.title: Pick your Workspace
walkthrough.workspace.description:
Belong to several ClickUp Workspaces? Choose the one you track time in. With a single Workspace this is already done.
[Select Workspace](command:clickupDevTimer.selectWorkspace)
walkthrough.track.title: Start tracking
walkthrough.track.description:
Pick a task and get coding. Only active time counts, and branches like `feature/CU-86bx123-fix-login` suggest the right task automatically.
[Select a Task](command:clickupDevTimer.selectTask)
walkthrough.settings.title: Fine-tune
walkthrough.settings.description:
Adjust the idle threshold, time rounding and time entry descriptions to match how your team works.
[Open Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22clickupDevTimer%22)
config.teamId: ClickUp Workspace (team) ID used to list tasks and log time. Filled in during setup.
config.activeStatuses: Task statuses treated as "in progress" (case-insensitive). These tasks are listed first.
config.inactivityThresholdSeconds: Seconds without activity before the timer pauses automatically. Idle time is not counted.
config.autoSaveIntervalSeconds: Interval in seconds for periodically saving the timer state to disk.
config.minimumEntrySeconds: Sessions shorter than this (in seconds) are discarded instead of synced.
config.roundingMinutes: Round the session total to a multiple of this many minutes. 0 disables rounding.
config.roundingMode: How the session total is rounded.
config.askDescriptionOnFinish: Ask for a time entry description when finishing a session. Turned off automatically when your ClickUp plan does not allow time entry descriptions; turn it on again to make ClickUp DevTimer retry them (e.g. after upgrading the plan).
config.defaultDescription: Default description suggested for time entries.
config.longPauseWarningMinutes: Warn when the timer has been manually paused for this many minutes. 0 disables the warning.
config.longSessionWarningMinutes: Warn after this many minutes of continuous tracking on the same task. 0 disables the warning.
config.suggestStatusChange: Suggest changing the task status when starting and finishing the timer.
config.branchDetection.enabled: Detect the ClickUp task from the current Git branch name.
config.branchDetection.patterns: Regular expressions used to extract the task ID from the branch name. Capture group 1 must contain the ID.
config.recentTasksCount: Number of recently used tasks shown at the top of the task picker.
config.taskCacheTtlMinutes: How long (in minutes) the task list is cached.
config.syncRetryIntervalMinutes: Interval in minutes for automatically retrying pending time entries.
config.statusBar.maxTaskNameLength: Maximum number of characters of the task name shown in the status bar.
config.weeklySummary: At the start of each week, show a short summary of the time logged the week before.
